04 / Behind the work

A foundation
in curiosity.

Completing an MSc in Applied Artificial Intelligence at Warwick, with a computer science foundation from IIT Ropar.

My work connects applied AI research with software engineering: evaluating language models, building full-stack workflows and understanding the systems below them.

At American Express, I developed SQL fraud-detection tools and Python automation. At Ambiente Technologies, I worked on face recognition and browser-based WebRTC features.
